title: Extract a shared pumpApp test helper — profiles feature hand-rolls the 4-delegate MaterialApp wrapper 13 times
why: TQ-3 calls for widget tests to pump via a shared pumpApp helper; test/helpers/ has no such file (verified contents: drift_memory.dart, firestore_fake.dart, golden_runner.dart, migration_test_helper.dart, overflow_harness.dart, test_database.dart). Each of the 4 widget-test files in this batch hand-rolls the identical MaterialApp+localizationsDelegates+supportedLocales block (6 separate occurrences inside pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart alone; 13 total in this batch), and the same block appears in 146 test files repo-wide (grepped for GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate). Any future change to the delegate list, theme, or a required test-only ancestor widget requires hand-editing every copy; a missed copy silently diverges from the rest.
recommendation: Add test/helpers/pump_app.dart exposing a pumpApp({child, overrides, locale}) helper and migrate these call sites onto it, starting with this batch's 4 files.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and is used by at least the 4 files in this batch
A tracked grep count of GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate outside test/helpers/ decreases as files migrate
mergedFrom: Add a Locale('he') RTL widget-test variant for ProfileSwitcherSheet and its AN-2 PIN guard
